# SlimSAM pretrained model

- **Source:** https://huggingface.co/Xenova/slimsam-77-uniform
- **Revision:** `5850ab45f587c112167512ffef949107115e26a0`
- **License:** Apache-2.0; see [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt).
- **Format:** ONNX INT8 image encoder and prompt encoder/mask decoder.

The ONNX conversion is supplied by Xenova/Hugging Face, based on SlimSAM and Segment Anything. ReThread did not train this model or validate its accuracy on textiles. Its actual foreground predictions are used for explicit local neural boundary review.

[Exact file sizes and SHA-256 values](provenance.json).
